confirmed_by: User in this QA session on 2026-11-20
rule: A profitable close starting exactly at the benchmark pays no manager share. Subsequent profitable closes pay the configured share only when balance before the close already exceeds the benchmark.
user_example: Benchmark 1000, first trade profit 7 is not shared; balance becomes 1007 and the second trade profit is shared.
brokerage_note: Live account brokerage is separately reconciled; the user example does not specify brokerage.
superseded_assertion: Expecting a positive manager share on the first profitable benchmark crossing was incorrect.
